clue.text: Admit everything, with cry of pain

parts.note: everything means all
ow is an exclamation of pain

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to it all, wincing as they do so.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit something in, or concede it, is to let or permit it.

clue.text: Port bow gets radio echo of unknown origin

parts.note: an arch is a bow shape
angel was RAF slang for an unexplained radar echo

explanation.surface: Bow-mounted radio picks up a mysterious signal.
explanation.walkthrough: ARCHANGEL is a port in northern Russia; 'Port' looks like the left side of a ship, beside 'bow'.
explanation.definitionFit: Arkhangelsk on the White Sea is a Russian seaport.

clue.text: Mean to get railway ticket in slack period

parts.note: low means mean or base
a season is a season ticket for rail travel

explanation.surface: A stingy commuter buys a cheap ticket during a quiet time.
explanation.definitionFit: The quiet part of the tourist year is its slack period.

clue.text: Pervert uses conflict to get power

parts.note: war is conflict
P is the symbol for power

explanation.surface: A deviant uses fighting to gain power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pervert' looks like a noun but is the verb, to twist or distort.
explanation.definitionFit: To pervert something is to twist or distort it.

clue.text: Animal finds plum in courtyard

indicators.note: in places the plum word inside the courtyard word

parts.note: a quad is a college courtyard
a drupe is a stone fruit such as a plum

explanation.surface: A creature stumbles on a fallen plum in a courtyard.
explanation.walkthrough: A drupe is the botanical name for any stone fruit, so a plum is one; QUAD wraps it to give QUA-DRUPE-D.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-footed beast is a typical example of an animal.

clue.text: At lightning speed, by comparison

parts.note: a simile likening great speed to a burst of light

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom compares great speed with a lightning bolt.

clue.text: Runs are hard to come by

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
taken as written

explanation.surface: In cricket, runs are hard to score.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarce and uncommon things are hard to come by.

clue.text: Force to speak, getting reward

indicators.note: to speak signals the word for force is heard, not read

parts.note: to prise is to force open

explanation.surface: Someone is compelled to talk in order to earn a reward.
explanation.definitionFit: A prize is a reward for winning.

clue.text: Shabby home improvements held no good

indicators.note: held means the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: DIY is do-it-yourself home improvement

explanation.surface: The home makeover was a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: Dingy means drab and grimy, a synonym of shabby.

clue.text: Caught, debtor has to cringe

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a debtor is one who owes, an ower

explanation.surface: A debtor is caught and has to shrink away in fear.
explanation.definitionFit: To cringe is to shrink back in fear, a synonym.

clue.text: Be liable for Jerusalem raid

parts.note: to incur is to become liable for
Sion (Zion) is a name for Jerusalem

explanation.surface: Someone is held answerable for an attack on Jerusalem.
explanation.definitionFit: An incursion is a sudden hostile invasion, a raid.

clue.text: I abandoned remorse about valley's gradual improvement

indicators.note: about means the trimmed remorse word goes round the valley word
abandoned says the letter I has been dropped

parts.note: a guilty conscience is remorse
vale is a valley

explanation.surface: Losing their guilt over a valley led to a slow recovery.
explanation.walkthrough: Remorse is felt as a pricking of conscience. 'I abandoned' leaves CONSCENCE, which 'about' wraps round the valley word; 'remorse' tempts an anagram, but it is a synonym here.
explanation.definitionFit: Recovering health over time after illness is a gradual improvement.

clue.text: They cut lines on graph

definitions.meaning: the x and y reference lines of a chart

explanation.definitionFit: Hatchets cut, and a graph's reference lines share the same plural spelling.

clue.text: To frighten this creature may put you in bad odour

definitions.text: To frighten this creature may put you in bad odour

parts.words: To frighten this creature may put you in bad odour
parts.note: alarming this animal makes it spray a foul smell, and being in bad odour also means being out of favour

explanation.definitionFit: This black-and-white mammal sprays a stinking liquid when threatened.

clue.text: Extremely clever youth hid

indicators.note: hid says the letters lie concealed inside the words clever youth

explanation.surface: A bright young person hid away.
explanation.definitionFit: Extremely and very are synonyms as intensifiers.

clue.text: Broke the spell

explanation.definitionFit: Something that split open has done so, and a short spell of effort is a sudden spurt.

clue.text: Almost all the writing for the certificate

indicators.note: almost all says the final letter of the writing word is dropped

parts.note: script is writing

explanation.surface: Nearly all of the text is needed for the document.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrip is a certificate of entitlement, as for shares.

clue.text: Using new large cushions for self-examination

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of large cushions take a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone tries out new big cushions as an aid to introspection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges the thirteen letters of LARGE CUSHIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Probing one's own motives and conscience is self-examination.

clue.text: In valley, love fine warm corner

parts.note: a glen is a Scottish valley
love is zero in tennis, O
OK means fine

explanation.surface: In a valley, a fine warm nook for love.
explanation.walkthrough: An INGLENOOK is a seat beside an open fireplace, hence a warm corner.
explanation.definitionFit: This fireside recess is a cosy, heated corner of a room.

clue.text: Wonderful to give birth to heavenly creature

parts.note: great means wonderful
to bear is to give birth to

explanation.surface: How wonderful to deliver an angelic baby.
explanation.walkthrough: The Great Bear is the constellation Ursa Major, an animal in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Ursa Major is a constellation shaped as an animal, so a creature in the heavens.

clue.text: Tolerant of so chronic a patient?

definitions.meaning: describing a sick person whose suffering goes on for a long time

explanation.definitionFit: Patiently enduring is tolerance, and a chronic patient literally suffers over a long period.

clue.text: Choose an implement

definitions.meaning: a pointed tool for breaking ground

explanation.definitionFit: To select is to pick, and a pickaxe is a digging tool.

clue.text: Sign of life in vegetables?

definitions.meaning: a heartbeat felt at the wrist
edible seeds such as lentils and beans

explanation.definitionFit: A heartbeat shows life, and lentils, peas and beans are legumes.

clue.text: Bloke has little time to break tenth commandment

parts.note: cove is old slang for a bloke
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: A man has only a moment to sin against the Decalogue.
explanation.walkthrough: The tenth commandment forbids desiring a neighbour's goods, so breaking it is to desire them.
explanation.definitionFit: The tenth commandment says not to crave a neighbour's things; breaking it means craving them.

clue.text: Dull church could be lighter

parts.note: mat, or matt, means dull and not shiny

explanation.surface: A dreary church might be brightened up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lighter' reads as brighter, but it is a noun: something that lights.
explanation.definitionFit: A match is a small stick used to light a fire, so a lighter.

clue.text: Son in black piece of humour

indicators.note: in puts the son letter inside the word for black

parts.note: jet means deep glossy black

explanation.surface: A son dressed in black makes a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A joke or quip is a piece of humour.

clue.text: Hospital going over limb that's hurt

indicators.note: going over places the hospital letter above the limb word in this down entry

parts.note: an arm is a limb

explanation.surface: A hospital checks over an injured limb.
explanation.definitionFit: Harm is injury or hurt, a synonym.

clue.text: Chatter quietly and show amazement

parts.note: to gas is to chatter
P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: People chat in hushed tones and express astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing a sharp breath shows amazement.

clue.text: Have Latin translation for sea monster

indicators.note: translation here means the letters of Have Latin are turned into another form

explanation.surface: Read some Latin and translate it to find a monster of the deep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' rearranges the letters of HAVE LATIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical giant of the deep is the archetypal sea monster.

clue.text: Stirred a frying-pan with energy

parts.note: a wok is a Chinese frying-pan
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone vigorously stirred a frying-pan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stirred' suggests cooking, but here it means roused from sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirred in the sense of roused from sleep is a synonym.

clue.text: Old-time soldiers are unprepared

parts.note: ex means former
tempo is musical time
RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers

explanation.surface: Veteran soldiers are caught off guard.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done on the spur of the moment, without rehearsal, is unprepared.

clue.text: Gambling game that rouses sparks?

definitions.meaning: a card game played for stakes
a fireside iron rod that stirs the embers

explanation.definitionFit: It is a card game for money and also a rod for stirring a fire.
